#XHED: Default title text for the export progress error message box
PROGRESS_ERROR_TITLE=Error

#XMSG: Message text informing that the exported file is too big

#XMSG: Part of a message text that informs about the file specific cell limit for exporting
MSG_WARNING_CELL_LIMIT=Documents with more than {0} cells might be too large to process.

#XMSG: Part of a message text that informs about the number of rows which will be exported
MSG_WARNING_ROW_COUNT=The document contains {0} rows.

#XMSG: Part of a message text that contains information about the file specific export limit - Placeholder 1 references the limit and placeholder 2 references the file type
MSG_WARNING_ROW_LIMIT=Only {0} rows can be exported in a single {1} file.

#XMSG: Part of a message text that gives advice on how to proceed

#XMSG: Last sentence of a warning message to ask the user if he/she still wants to export

#XMSG: Textual representation of the technical error message which indicates that the export ran out of memory.

#XMSG: Message text informing that the original error message is empty or no specific error provided

#XHED: Default title text for the export settings dialog
EXPORT_SETTINGS_TITLE=Export As

#XFLD: Label for File Name input field
FILE_NAME=File Name

#XFLD: Label for the file format Select control

#XFLD: Split cells with multiple values
SPLIT_CELLS=Split cells with multiple values

			<base>config</base>
			<location>JSON:tileConfiguration\JSON:TILE_PROPERTIES\JSON:.
			</location>
		</source>

			<base>config</base>

	</sources>

	<propertyPaths>
		<properties source="tilePropertiesBag" usage="display">
			<property name="display-title_text">title</property>
			<property name="display-subtitle_text">description</property>
		</properties>

		<properties source="tilePropertiesConfig" usage="navigation">
			<property source="calc" name="navigation-type">"I"</property>
			<property name="navigation-intent-semantic_object">semanticObject</property>
			<property name="navigation-intent-semantic_action">semanticAction</property>
			<property source="comp" name="navigation-intent-semantic_parameters"
				false="ssb_additional_navigation_semantic_parameters" true="ssb_generic_navigation_semantic_parameters">ssb_navType=ssb_generic_navType
			</property>
			<property source="comp"
				name="ssb_generic_navigation_semantic_parameters" false="ssb_default_semantic_parameters"
				true="ssb_evaluation_semantic_parameters">ssb_reportID=null</property>
			<property source="comp" name="ssb_default_semantic_parameters"
				false="ssb_report_semantic_parameters" true="ssb_evaluation_semantic_parameters">ssb_evaluationID=ssb_reportID
			</property>
			<property source="calc"
				name="ssb_additional_navigation_semantic_parameters">{additional:"&"~name~"="~value:}</property>
			<property source="calc" name="ssb_evaluation_semantic_parameters">"EvaluationId="~ssb_evaluationID~ssb_additional_navigation_semantic_parameters
			</property>
			<property source="calc" name="ssb_report_semantic_parameters">"ReportId="~ssb_reportID~ssb_additional_navigation_semantic_parameters
			</property>
			<property source="calc" name="ssb_generic_navType">"0"</property>

			</property>
			<property name="ssb_evaluationID">evaluationId</property>
			<property name="ssb_reportID">reportId</property>
			<property name="ssb_navType">navType</property>

		</properties>
	</propertyPaths>
	<contracts>
		<consume id="configuration">
			<parameters>
				<parameter name="tileConfiguration" />

		<consume id="preview" />
		<consume id="search" />
		<consume id="configurationUi" />
		<consume id="bag" />
	</contracts>

#XMSG: Tooltip that explains the Accessibility checkbox and why it might be disabled

#XBUT: Cancel button in the dialog

PROGRESS_TITLE=Export Document

#XHED: Default title text for the export warning dialog
WARNING_TITLE=Warning

PROGRESS_ERROR_TITLE=Error

#XMSG: Message text informing that the exported file is too big

#XMSG: Part of a message text that informs about the file specific cell limit for exporting
MSG_WARNING_CELL_LIMIT=Documents with more than {0} cells might be too large to process.
